## File: facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py

Prompts

```
['build a SwinTransformer backbone with configurable depths, num_heads, window_size, and embed_dim for semantic segmentation', 'create a D2SwinTransformer registered in Detectron2 BACKBONE_REGISTRY using config MODEL.SWIN parameters', 'review the WindowAttention class for multi-head self-attention with relative position bias in shifted windows', 'test the SwinTransformerBlock forward pass with cyclic shift, window partitioning, and W-MSA/SW-MSA attention', 'refactor the PatchMerging layer to downsample features by merging 2x2 patches and reducing channel dimension']
```

Usage

```
{'build_swin_transformer_backbone': 'build a SwinTransformer backbone with configurable depths, num_heads, window_size, and embed_dim for semantic segmentation', 'create_d2_swin_transformer': 'create a D2SwinTransformer registered in Detectron2 BACKBONE_REGISTRY using config MODEL.SWIN parameters', 'review_window_attention': 'review the WindowAttention class for multi-head self-attention with relative position bias in shifted windows', 'test_swin_transformer_block': 'test the SwinTransformerBlock forward pass with cyclic shift, window partitioning, and W-MSA/SW-MSA attention', 'refactor_patch_merging': 'refactor the PatchMerging layer to downsample features by merging 2x2 patches and reducing channel dimension'}
```
